snippet.title: Earth Day Celebration : Grow Wild demo launch! | Download cozy nature game on Steam PC & Mac
snippet.description:
To celebrate Earth Day and the beautiful planet that we live on, we have released the first demo of our cozy nature game 🌱Grow Wild🌸

Join the Nature Club and transform empty landscapes into thriving living ecosystems - all based on real species and ecological priciples.

👉 Play demo on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4609740/Grow_Wild_Demo/

🎮 Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230260/Grow_Wild/

💬 Join our community on Discord - https://discord.gg/B9S8AZCXt4

🌱 Game website -  https://www.grow-wild-game.com

Official Trailer

#earthday #rewilding #growwild #climatechange
